sovereign_clinical.primary_material: Matte lacquer flat-front panels, zero visible hardware
sovereign_clinical.secondary_material: Honed travertine or polished concrete flooring
sovereign_clinical.textile: Tight-weave wool or bouclé in single solid tones, no pattern
sovereign_clinical.metal_hardware: Push-to-open mechanisms only — no visible pulls or knobs

sovereign_precision.primary_material: Book-matched walnut veneer with visible grain symmetry
sovereign_precision.secondary_material: Brushed stainless or matte black steel structural legs
sovereign_precision.textile: Structured wool flannel, precise piping seams
sovereign_precision.metal_hardware: Fine linear brushed-steel pulls, symmetrical placement only

sage_hermit.primary_material: Raw, low-sheen oiled oak — matte, tactile, non-reflective
sage_hermit.secondary_material: Natural wool felt panels for acoustic dampening
sage_hermit.textile: Heavy raw linen, undyed wool, nothing glossy or reflective
sage_hermit.metal_hardware: Blackened iron or none — hardware should disappear visually

sage_scholar.primary_material: Solid wood shelving (oak or ash), open grain, library character
sage_scholar.secondary_material: Leather desk surfaces, aged patina welcome
sage_scholar.textile: Wool tweed, corduroy — textured but calm, muted tones only
sage_scholar.metal_hardware: Aged brass reading-lamp fittings, warm tone

alchemist_fluid.primary_material: Lightweight engineered composites — easy to move, low mass
alchemist_fluid.secondary_material: Soft-rubber caster wheels on every mobile piece
alchemist_fluid.textile: Performance-weave fabric, stain-resistant, adaptable to reconfiguration
alchemist_fluid.metal_hardware: Locking casters and quick-release brackets, brushed nickel
avoid: Anything requiring two people to move

alchemist_chaotic.primary_material: Exposed plywood or OSB edge-banded panels — workshop honesty
alchemist_chaotic.secondary_material: Pegboard (painted MDF or metal) as a structural wall material
alchemist_chaotic.textile: Canvas, denim-weight cotton — durable, visibly functional
alchemist_chaotic.metal_hardware: Exposed bolts, visible brackets, industrial hooks
avoid: Anything that can't be wiped down

weaver_intimate.primary_material: Warm oak or cane (hazeran) panel doors, natural texture visible
weaver_intimate.secondary_material: High-pile wool or jute rugs as the room's acoustic anchor
weaver_intimate.textile: Bouclé, heavy linen, wool throws — layered and touchable
weaver_intimate.metal_hardware: Warm brass or bronze, softly aged, never cold chrome

weaver_dynamic.primary_material: Durable honey-toned oak, high-traffic sealed finish
weaver_dynamic.secondary_material: Stain-resistant woven upholstery for high-guest-volume seating
weaver_dynamic.textile: Tight-weave washable fabrics, warm tones, easy-clean priority
weaver_dynamic.metal_hardware: Brushed brass, durable and warm, resistant to fingerprints
avoid: Delicate silk or velvet in high-traffic zones
Fragile glass surfaces near circulation paths
